text_block_list.text: A Racewear outfit arrived for Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It feels very comfortable and easy to run in.
Just as ordered.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer.
Would it be all right if I stepped outside for just a bit—"
choice_data_list: It's already night, so let's do it tomorrow.
It's already nighttime, so let's save it for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
See you tomorrow, then.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

The next morning.
Since Silence Suzuka was so eager, I arrived
at the track early in the morning, only to find—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...A pleasant breeze.
It feels so—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Alright, one more lap—!

"The profile of Silence Suzuka running on the track
looked so genuinely full of joy—"
I hesitated to call out to her.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Hah...
Not yet, I need more—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... Good morning?
choice_data_list: How did it feel running in your racing outfit?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... My legs just moved naturally.
Toward whatever felt good—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Why, I wonder...
Could it really be thanks to the color...?

I think about Silence Suzuka's words.
The colors designed into her racing silks are...
choice_data_list: Oh, so you like green, huh?
You really like white, don't you?

text_block_list.text:
I think about Silence Suzuka's words.
The colors designed into her racing silks are...
choice_data_list: Oh, so you like green, huh?
You really like white, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Green—the color of the turf, and my favorite color right now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Whenever I wear this racing attire, it makes me feel like I'm already out on the turf."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Once the race started, I was surrounded by so many girls.
But from there, I ran and ran—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Breaking free, the world opens wide.
No one else is there... A view that belongs only to me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I want to race and savor this feeling again and again—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Just imagining it makes my legs... itch to run.
I think I'll go run a little more.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Now then—
choice_data_list: Class is about to start, you know?!
Class is about to start, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I-Is it already that time...?

At any rate, the racing racewear seemed
to provide great inspiration for Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The silvery landscape... that I fell in love with as a child.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
On days when it was snowing...
I used to spend the whole day running outside.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
On and on, forever and ever—
Through the endlessly falling snow, on and on.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
All I could hear was my own breathing and heartbeat...
It was such a quiet world.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I wanted to reach that world, so I—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Fufufu.
That's right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No. Talking about the past just made
my legs feel antsy...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Now then—
choice_data_list: Class is about to start, you know?!
Class is about to start, you know?!

text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I-Is it already that time...?

At any rate, the racing racewear seemed
to provide great inspiration for Silence Suzuka.
